u0: No client is currently waiting and no order is in progress. The siren may ring at any time and should be silenced by walking to the switch and toggling it. Next objective: watch for a client to arrive at the counter; upon client_arrived, move to take their order.
u1: A client is waiting at the counter but their order has not been taken. Navigate to a floor cell next to the counter facing the client and toggle to take the order. Optionally silence the siren first if it rings.
u2: The waiting client's order is taken, and the agent does not yet hold food. Go to the pantry, face it and pick up a raw portion of food; the first pickup is guaranteed to slip soon, so be ready to recover it.
u3: The agent is carrying raw food for the order that has been taken. Carry it to the stove, face it and toggle to prepare it; keep an eye out for the food slipping, in which case switch to recovery and pick it up on the very next move.
u4: The agent is carrying prepared food for the waiting client. Navigate to the counter and toggle while facing the client to serve the order. If the food slips first, recover it immediately and take it back to the stove.
u5: The food has slipped out of the agent's hands and lies on a nearby floor cell; the agent now faces it. Next objective: move forward or pick up to regain the food on the very next move, then resume carrying it to the stove (if raw) or to the client (if prepared).
u6: An order was just served and the agent's hands are now empty; this is a transition state heading back to the idle loop. Check for a ringing siren and silence it if needed, then wait for the next client_arrived to begin a new order.
u7: Terminal success state: the most recent client's order was fully completed (either served or the prepared-food step closed the cycle) and the agent is idle awaiting the next client. Continue handling any ringing siren; if a new client arrives, transition to taking their order.
